result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders.

**Change:** `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (around line 6518). The purchase-order subquery gets `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the per-quarter and latest-purchase-order queries already use. Ordering and the zero-count rows for reps without purchase orders are unchanged.

**Verification:** `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` (3 tests) and `QuarterPurchaseOrdersTest` (3 tests) pass offline. The existing tests don't include a cancelled purchase order, so they don't exercise the new filter. I didn't add a test for it; say if you want one.

Nothing is committed.
